text:
maria: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's S3/backpressure incident. capturing a compact set of test additions and ownership so we don't lose these fixes.

samir: thanks. short list please — want to slot into next sprint.

maria: ok pasted below. split into Testing (regression/prompt sets), Load & infra tests, and Operational drills. each item has suggested owner & minimal acceptance criteria.

- TEST-01: Incident prompt bucket. collect all prompts that triggered truncated or fallback behaviour during the incident; store as tests/regression/incident_buckets/s3_backpressure.txt. owner: leo. acceptance: CI runs the bucket and flags the exact failure signature (truncated_response OR missing_tool_call).
- TEST-02: Regression harness for model-fallback. create an automated test that simulates a graceful pod drain and expects traffic to switch to fallback model variant without 5xxs or corrupted responses. owner: samir + eng-runtime. acceptance: end-to-end in staging, pass on 3 consecutive runs.
- TEST-03: Load profile reproducer (k6/locust). model a fanout pattern where a single request fanouts to 5 backend attention/kv reads, exercising KV cache eviction and connection limits. owner: anya. acceptance: reproducible 95th/99th latency bump in staging that matches production symptom graph.
- TEST-04: KV cache hit-ratio sweep. add parametric tests that vary KV hit ratio from 20%->95% to ensure latency/throughput curves remain within SLA. owner: eng-runtime (samir). acceptance: threshold curves documented, alerts tuned.
- TEST-05: Quarterly chaos drill. 2-hour window that runs TEST-01/02/03 with oncall + infra present. include checklist for role handoffs and rollback paths. owner: jordan. acceptance: drill run & retro notes posted, any failures triaged into JIRA.
- OPS-01: Alert correlation rule. if 3 s3-related incidents within 30 days, tag as recurring-pattern and escalate to postmortem lead. owner: ops team. acceptance: rule deployed and validated with synthetic events.

leo: I'll take TEST-01. plan: extract prompts, add a tiny pytest harness that asserts the failure fingerprint (we'll look for escape sequences/null tool callbacks). ETA: Thu EOD.

anya: I'll start TEST-03 with a locust scenario (prefer locust for long-running connection patterns). will parameterize KV hit ratio and open it as RWINF-1123. need infra help for ephemeral staging GPUs to run the full flow.

samir: I'll partner on TEST-02 + TEST-04. for the fallback test we should add a traffic-mirroring canary in staging that forces a graceful drain using the same kube drain hooks we saw in prod. ETA: 2 weeks.

jordan: I'll schedule the first chaos drill for the quarter. planning doc and checklist by next Monday. will include a communications playbook for PD and status pages.

ops-bot: Created ticket RWINF-1123: "s3-backpressure-load-reproducer" (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWINF-1123)
ops-bot: Created ticket RWINF-1124: "incident-prompt-bucket" (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RWINF-1124)

maria: adding a governance note: label every incident-derived test with `incident-regression` and require an owner in JIRA before closing the postmortem. also propose a monthly sweep to remove stale buckets older than 6 months.

samir: acceptance criteria question: do we want automated pass/fail only, or human review for some prompts?

maria: hybrid. deterministic checks for obvious failures (truncation, missing tool calls). add a small human-eval sample (5-10 prompts) for quality regressions. where possible gate rollouts on those metrics.

leo: quick run command for reviewers (local):
```bash
# run the incident prompt bucket locally
pytest tests/regression/test_incident_buckets.py::test_s3_backpressure -q
```

anya: locust sketch:
```python
from locust import HttpUser, task, between
class S3BackpressureUser(HttpUser):
    wait_time = between(0.01, 0.2)
    @task
    def gen(self):
        self.client.post('/v1/generate', json={'prompt': '...'}, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer '+os.getenv('TOKEN')})
```

jordan: checklist items I'll include for the drill: pre-drill stakeholder notice, PD escalation contact list, quick rollback actions, SLOs to verify, post-drill retro.

maria: timeline recap (tentative):
- RWINF-1124 (prompt bucket): leo, ETA Thu EOD
- RWINF-1123 (load reproducer): anya, ETA next Wed
- RWINF-1125 (fallback regression): samir + eng-runtime, ETA 2w
- RWINF-1126 (quarterly chaos drill): jordan, planning doc Mon, drill next quarter
- RWINF-1127 (alert correlation): ops, ETA 3 days

samir: I'll add the fallback canary to staging and wire up the test. ping me if you want to pair.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall handover tomorrow 09:00 — please ensure any action owners have acknowledged (react :bell:).

maria: please ack in JIRA when you accept the ticket. I'll follow up in next week's eng-sre sync to confirm progress and close the loop. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
